lesson_examples.en: My mom doesn't speak English very well.

lesson_examples.jp: 英語（えいご）は　読（よ）めますが　話（はな）せません。
lesson_examples.en: I can read English, but I can't speak it.

建.etymology: Compound ideograph: a brush (聿) drafting plans along a long stride (廴) — pacing out the site, plans in hand: to build, to erect.
建.mnemonic: Blueprint in one hand, long strides across the empty lot — たてる. A 建物 is a drawing that learned to stand.

lesson_examples.jp: あの　建物（たてもの）は　何（なに）ですか？
まいにち　建（た）てる。

験.etymology: Phono-semantic: horse (馬) + a phonetic (僉, ケン) — testing horses before buying them: verification by trial.
験.mnemonic: Ride the horse around the yard before you pay: that ride is the test — ケン. 試験 and 経験: exams and experience, both just laps on the horse.

lesson_examples.jp: 試験（しけん）　頑張（がんば）ってね。
留学（りゅうがく）の　経験（けいけん）は　お　ありですか？

好.etymology: Compound ideograph: woman (女) + child (子) — a mother with her child: affection itself; good, beloved.
好.mnemonic: Mother and child leaning into each other: the warmest picture the script owns — すき. 大好き stacks 'big' on top and means it.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　格好（かっこう）いい。
今（こん）　好（す）きな　人（ひと）　いる？

菜.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 采 'a hand picking from a tree' (phonetic サイ) — greens gathered by hand: vegetables, side dishes.
菜.mnemonic: A hand in the greens, picking dinner leaf by leaf — な, サイ. 野菜: the pickings of the open field.

lesson_examples.jp: 好（す）きな　野菜（やさい）は　何（なに）ですか？
この　野菜（やさい）、英語（えいご）で　何（なに）ていうの？
lesson_examples.en: What do you call this vegetable in English?

産.etymology: Compound: a phonetic top (产) over 生 'life' — life brought forth: to bear, to produce; hence products and property.
産.mnemonic: Under the overhang, new life (生) arrives — うむ. Farms 生産 their crops, mothers 出産, and the 産 on souvenir boxes means 'born here': 北海道産.

lesson_examples.jp: お　土産（みやげ）　何（なん）　買（か）ったの？
lesson_examples.en: What kind of souvenirs did you buy?

lesson_examples.jp: これは　遺産（いさん）です。

試.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 式 'set form, ceremony' (phonetic シ) — putting performance against the set form: to test, to try.
試.mnemonic: Read the standard aloud (言), then try to match it (式) — ためす. 試験 measures the gap; 試着 is the fitting-room version.

lesson_examples.jp: 試験（しけん）　頑張（がんば）ってね。
トムは　試（ため）したの？

借.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 昔 'long ago' (phonetic シャク) — a person trading on old ties: to borrow.
借.mnemonic: 'Remember old times (昔)? So… could I borrow it?' — かりる. Debts age like the kanji says: from yesterday's favor to ancient history.

lesson_examples.jp: 電話（でんわ）　借（か）りても　いい？
ドライヤー　借（か）りても　いい？
lesson_examples.en: Can I borrow the hair dryer?

説.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 兌 'to loosen, exchange' (phonetic セツ) — words that unravel a knot: to explain; a theory.
説.mnemonic: Talk (言) until the tangled thing comes loose (兌) — セツ. 説明 is untying in public; a 小説 unties a whole life, slowly.

lesson_examples.jp: 説明（せつめい）　させてください。
来週（らいしゅう）　詳（くわ）しく　説明（せつめい）　します。
lesson_examples.en: I'll explain in detail next week.

低.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 氐 'base, bottom' (phonetic テイ) — a person down at the base line: low.
低.mnemonic: Someone crouched at the foundation line, head below the fence — ひくい. Low prices, low voices, low ceilings: all down at 氐.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　声（こえ）が　低（ひく）い。
トムは　低（てい）　血圧（けつあつ）だ。

働.etymology: A kokuji — a kanji invented in Japan: person (亻) + 動 'move' — a person in motion: to work. China later borrowed it back.
働.mnemonic: A person set in motion and kept there: work — はたらく. Japan needed a kanji for it badly enough to build one from scratch.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　よく　働（はたら）く。
トムは　働（はたら）けない。

特.etymology: Phono-semantic: ox (牛) + 寺 'temple' (phonetic トク) — the bull chosen for the temple sacrifice: singled out, special.
特.mnemonic: Of the whole herd, one bull gets the temple ribbon — トク. 特別, 特急: whatever wears the ribbon skips the line.

lesson_examples.jp: 特技（とくぎ）は　どこでも　寝（ね）られる　ことです。
lesson_examples.en: My special skill is being able to sleep anywhere.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　特許（とっきょ）です。

飯.etymology: Phono-semantic: food (飠) + 反 'turn over' (phonetic ハン) — rice turned in the pot as it steams: cooked rice, the meal itself.
飯.mnemonic: Fold the rice over once more before serving — ごはん. In Japanese, 'meal' and 'rice' are the same word, and this kanji is why.

lesson_examples.jp: 今日（きょう）の　晩（ばん）　ご飯（はん）　カレーだと　いいな。
lesson_examples.en: It'd be nice if we had curry for dinner tonight.

lesson_examples.jp: よかったら　今度（こんど）　一緒（いっしょ）に　ご飯（はん）でも　行（い）きませんか？
lesson_examples.en: Would it be okay if we went out to eat together this time?

不.etymology: Origin debated — a flower calyx, or a bird beating upward and never arriving. Pure negation since the oracle bones: un-, non-, not.
不.mnemonic: A bird flapping at the underside of the sky, never getting through — フ. Stick it on anything and the thing fails: 不便, 不安, 不可能.

lesson_examples.jp: そんな　の　不公平（ふこうへい）じゃない？
何（なに）が　そんなに　不満（ふまん）な　んですか？

別.etymology: Compound ideograph: flesh parted from the bone with a blade (刂) — to divide cleanly: separate, distinct, another.
別.mnemonic: One clean stroke of the cleaver and it's two things now — わかれる, ベツ. 別々に: 'separately, please' — the check gets the blade too.

lesson_examples.jp: そんなに　トムが　好（す）きなら　私（わたし）と　別（わか）れて　トムと　付（つ）き合（あ）えば？
lesson_examples.en: If you like Tom so much, why not break up with me and date him?

lesson_examples.jp: これは　個別（こべつ）です。

便.etymology: Compound: person (亻) + 更 'change, renew' — a person smoothing things over for others: convenience; the courier who makes distance convenient: the post.
便.mnemonic: The fixer who rearranges (更) everything until it's easy — ベン; and the mail (ビン) that spares you the trip. 便利: life with the fixer on call.

lesson_examples.jp: 郵便局（ゆうびんきょく）の　営業（えいぎょう）　時間（じかん）は　何時（なんじ）からですか？
lesson_examples.en: When does the post office open?

lesson_examples.jp: これは　便（びん）です。

民.etymology: Grim origin: an eye pierced by a needle — the blinded captives of early states, hence 'the subjects, the common people'. The meaning softened into 'the people, the nation'.
民.mnemonic: The masses packed under one low roof-stroke, anonymous by design — ミン. 国民, 市民: the crowd every government answers to (eventually).

lesson_examples.jp: この　まちの　住民（じゅうみん）です。
lesson_examples.en: I'm a resident of this town.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　民族（みんぞく）です。

examples.reading: こうきょうりょうきん

料.etymology: Compound ideograph: rice (米) + measuring ladle (斗) — grain measured out: materials, provisions, and the measured price: fee.
料.mnemonic: Scoop the rice, level it, name the price — リョウ. 料理 measures ingredients; 料金 measures your wallet.

lesson_examples.jp: 手数料（てすうりょう）は　いくらですか。
入場料（にゅうじょうりょう）は　いくらですか？

愛.etymology: Compound: a hand drawing something under cover, the heart (心) held close, feet trailing slow (夂) — walking carefully with a full heart: love.
愛.mnemonic: Carrying a heart so carefully your feet forget to hurry — あい. The kanji walks the way people in love actually walk.

lesson_examples.jp: トムの　こと　愛（あい）し　てるの？
愛（あい）し　てるよ、いつまでも。
lesson_examples.en: I love you and I always will.

案.etymology: Phono-semantic: 安 'at ease' (phonetic アン) + wood (木) — the desk one leans on at ease; what is drafted there: a plan, a proposal.
案.mnemonic: Elbows on the wooden desk, turning the idea over in comfort — アン. 案内 hands your plan to a stranger politely.

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　案（あん）じる。
これは　図案（ずあん）です。

位.etymology: Compound ideograph: a person (亻) at their standing-place (立) in the court line-up — one's position: rank, grade.
位.mnemonic: Everyone stands exactly where their title puts them — イ. 一位, 二位: the podium is just this kanji with steps.

lesson_examples.jp: たいかいで　1位（い）に　なりました。
lesson_examples.en: I took first place in the tournament.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　優位（ゆうい）です。

衣.etymology: Pictograph: a robe with its crossed collar and trailing hems — clothing. As a component (衤) it dresses kanji like 服's cousins 被 and 裏.
衣.mnemonic: The kimono collar crossing at the throat, hem sweeping the floor — ころも, イ. 衣服: the kanji you put on every day.

lesson_examples.jp: あたたかい　衣（ころも）を　きます。
これは　衣類（いるい）です。

印.etymology: Compound ideograph: a hand pressing a kneeling figure down — pressing from above: to stamp; the seal so pressed.
印.mnemonic: Press straight down and hold: the mark takes — しるし, イン. In Japan the 印鑑 outranks your signature.

lesson_examples.jp: こちらに　印鑑（いんかん）か　サインを　お願（ねが）い　します。
lesson_examples.en: Your seal or signature here, please.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　印刷（いんさつ）です。

栄.etymology: Simplified from 榮: torches blazing around a tree in full bloom — splendor, prosperity: to flourish.
栄.mnemonic: A tree lit up like a festival, every branch a lantern — さかえる. 栄光: the tree at maximum wattage.

lesson_examples.jp: まちが　栄（さか）えて　います。
まいにち　栄（さか）える。

塩.etymology: Simplified from 鹽: brine worked in pans (皿) on the shore (土) — sea-water boiled down: salt.
塩.mnemonic: Seawater in the flat dish, sun and fire doing the rest: white crystals — しお. The one rock you eat daily.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　卵（たまご）に　塩（しお）を　かけた。
lesson_examples.en: Tom put some salt on his eggs.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　塩（しお）です。

億.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 意 (phonetic オク) — a number at the edge of what a mind can hold: one hundred million.
億.mnemonic: A person trying to imagine (意) the crowd: 100,000,000 — オク. Japan counts its population in 億 — barely.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　億（おく）です。
これは　億劫（おっくう）です。

加.etymology: Compound ideograph: strength (力) added to the voice (口) — piling on: to add, to join.
加.mnemonic: Push (力) your word (口) onto the pile: +1 — くわえる. 参加 is adding yourself; カナダ borrowed it for its own name: 加奈陀.

lesson_examples.jp: しあいに　参加（さんか）します。
lesson_examples.en: I take part in the match.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　加工（かこう）です。

果.etymology: Pictograph: a tree (木) with a round fruit heavy at its top — fruit; what ripens from actions: result.
果.mnemonic: The tree holds up its finished work — くだもの (果物), the fruit; 結果, the fruit of everything else.

lesson_examples.jp: カリフォルニアは　果物（くだもの）で　有名（ゆうめい）です。
lesson_examples.en: California is famous for its fruit.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　果（は）てしないです。

課.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 果 'result' (phonetic カ) — tasks assigned and reckoned by results: a lesson, an administrative section.
課.mnemonic: Assignments handed out, fruit expected by Friday — カ. 第一課 in the textbook, 課長 at the office: same harvest logic.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　課程（かてい）です。
これは　課題（かだい）です。

貨.etymology: Phono-semantic: 化 'change' (phonetic カ) + money (貝) — goods that change into money and back: wares, freight, currency.
貨.mnemonic: Boxes that are just money in disguise (化) — カ. 貨物 rides the rails; 硬貨 jingles in your pocket.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　外貨（がいか）です。
これは　硬貨（こうか）です。

改.etymology: Compound ideograph: the self (己) under the correcting hand (攵) — beaten into better shape: to reform, revise.
改.mnemonic: Take the stick to your own habits — あらためる. 改札 reforms your ticket; 改善 reforms everything else, kaizen.

lesson_examples.jp: わるい　くせを　改（あらた）めます。
これは　改装（かいそう）です。

械.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 戒 'restrain' (phonetic カイ) — originally wooden fetters; any engineered wooden device: a contraption, machinery.
械.mnemonic: Wood that holds and moves by design: first shackles, then machines — カイ. 機械: the contraption fully grown.

lesson_examples.jp: この　機械（きかい）の　使（つか）い方（かた）　分（わ）かりますか？
lesson_examples.en: Do you know how to use this machine?

lesson_examples.jp: これは　械（かせ）です。

害.etymology: Compound: under a roof (宀), a gouging instrument (丰) over a mouth (口) — damage done within the house: harm, injury.
害.mnemonic: The wound happens indoors, where it isn't supposed to — ガイ. 公害, 被害: harm with an address.

lesson_examples.jp: それは　害（がい）に　なります。
まいにち　害（がい）する。

各.etymology: Compound ideograph: a foot (夂) arriving at a doorway (口) — arrivals one at a time: each, respectively.
各.mnemonic: One visitor at a time crossing the doorstep — カク. 各駅停車: the train that greets each station personally.

lesson_examples.jp: 各地（かくち）から　ひとが　あつまる。
これは　各地（かくち）です。

覚.etymology: Simplified from 覺: the crown of learning over 見 'see' — seeing with sudden clarity: to awaken; to fix in mind: to memorize.
覚.mnemonic: The lights snap on over your eyes: got it, and I'm keeping it — おぼえる; 目が覚める, the same lights at 7 a.m.

lesson_examples.jp: 自分（じぶん）で　言（い）った　こと　覚（おぼ）え　てないの？
lesson_examples.en: Don't you remember what you said?

lesson_examples.jp: これは　発覚（はっかく）です。

完.etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 元 (phonetic カン) — the house finished down to the roofbeam: complete.
完.mnemonic: The last tile set on the roof: nothing left to build — カン. 完成! — stamp it and step back.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　完成（かんせい）です。
これは　完了（かんりょう）です。

官.etymology: Compound ideograph: officials quartered (𠂤) under the state roof (宀) — government officers: the bureaucrat.
官.mnemonic: Under the official roof, the staff stack like sediment — カン. 警察官, 外交官: give a roof a stamp and it breeds officials.

lesson_examples.jp: かれは　官（かん）です。
これは　警察官（けいさつかん）です。

管.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 官 (phonetic カン) — the hollow bamboo tube: a pipe; what flows must be managed: control.
管.mnemonic: Bamboo plumbing with an official in charge of the valves — くだ. 管理: bureaucracy applied to pipes, then to everything.

lesson_examples.jp: 水道管（すいどうかん）が　こおりました。
これは　只管（ひたすら）です。

観.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 觀): 雚 'heron' (phonetic カン) + 見 'see' — the heron's fixed stare over the marsh: to observe; a view.
観.mnemonic: Stand heron-still and just watch — カン. 観光 is doing it on vacation; 観客 doing it in seats.

lesson_examples.jp: 映画（えいが）　観（み）る　前（まえ）に　原作（げんさく）　読（よ）ん　どけばよかった。
lesson_examples.en: I should've read the original work before watching the movie.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　外観（がいかん）です。

関.etymology: Simplified from 關: a gate (門) with its cross-bolts — the checkpoint barrier; what passes through it: connections.
関.mnemonic: The bolt across the gate decides who's connected to whom — カン. 関係: the doors between people; 関西: west of the barrier.

lesson_examples.jp: トムには　関係（かんけい）　ない　んだ。
トムは　政治（せいじ）に　無（む）　関心（かんしん）だ。
lesson_examples.en: Tom is not interested in politics.

願.etymology: Phono-semantic: 原 (phonetic ガン) + head (頁) — the head bowed at the source of authority: to petition, to wish.
願.mnemonic: Head lowered all the way to the spring — ねがう. お願いします: the everyday bow this kanji performs.

lesson_examples.jp: お　勘定（かんじょう）　お願（ねが）い　します。
チェック　アウト　お願（ねが）い　します。

器.etymology: Compound ideograph, classically read: four vessels (口×4) with a dog (犬) guarding them — the household's utensils; by extension, capacity.
器.mnemonic: Four bowls and one dog on duty between them — うつわ. 楽器, 食器: instruments and dishes, all guarded goods.

lesson_examples.jp: ピアノの　他（ほか）に　何（なに）か　楽器（がっき）　やっ　てる？
lesson_examples.en: Do you play any other instruments besides the piano?

lesson_examples.jp: これは　器（うつわ）です。

希.etymology: Compound: threads crossed sparse (㐅) over cloth (巾) — a weave so loose it's rare; what is rare is longed for: hope.
希.mnemonic: A weave with more gaps than thread: rare as the thing you're hoping for — キ. 希望: hope, honest about the odds.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　希少（きしょう）です。
これは　希薄（きはく）です。

機.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 幾 (phonetic キ) — the wooden loom, the first machine; hence mechanism, and the critical moment its trigger implies.
機.mnemonic: The loom clacks: wood doing arithmetic — キ. 飛行機, 洗濯機, チャンスは機会 — every machine and moment descends from it.

lesson_examples.jp: 洗濯機（せんたくき）から　変（へん）な　音（おと）が　し　てるよ。
lesson_examples.en: The washing machine is making a strange sound.

lesson_examples.jp: この　機械（きかい）の　使（つか）い方（かた）　分（わ）かりますか？
lesson_examples.en: Do you know how to use this machine?

季.etymology: Compound ideograph: grain (禾) + child (子) — the youngest grain of the year; each round of planting: a season.
季.mnemonic: The grain's newest child arrives four times a year — キ. 季節: the calendar told by what's sprouting.

lesson_examples.jp: 季節（きせつ）が　かわりました。
これは　四季（しき）です。

議.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 義 'what is right' (phonetic ギ) — arguing out the right course: deliberation.
議.mnemonic: Words wrestling over what's right, at length — ギ. 会議: the room; 議論: the sport played in it.

lesson_examples.jp: 午後（ごご）の　会議（かいぎ）、出（で）る？
lesson_examples.en: Are you going to be at this afternoon's meeting?

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　会議（かいぎ）を　欠席（けっせき）　した。

求.etymology: Pictograph: a fur garment — borrowed since antiquity for 'to seek, to request' (the original sense lives on in 裘).
求.mnemonic: Reaching for the warm pelt in midwinter: pure wanting — もとめる. 求人: companies doing the reaching.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　求職中（きゅうしょくちゅう）だ。
lesson_examples.en: Tom is looking for a job.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　追求（ついきゅう）です。

泣.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 立 (phonetic キュウ) — tears while standing: to weep (quietly — the loud kind is 鳴).
泣.mnemonic: Standing still while the water runs down — なく. The kanji cries without moving; so do most adults.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　泣（な）いていた。
トムが　泣（な）いている。

給.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 合 (phonetic キュウ) — thread supplied to match the need: to provide; what's provided monthly: salary.
給.mnemonic: The supply line feeds you exactly what fits — キュウ. 給料: the thread that arrives on the 25th.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　配給（はいきゅう）です。
これは　供給（きょうきゅう）です。

漁.etymology: Compound ideograph: water (氵) + fish (魚) — going after fish in the water: fishing.
漁.mnemonic: Fish plus water plus intent — リョウ. A 漁師 is the fish kanji with a boat and a schedule.

lesson_examples.jp: 漁（りょう）に　でます。
これは　漁業（ぎょぎょう）です。

競.etymology: Compound ideograph: two figures (立+兄) side by side, straining forward — a footrace in kanji form: to compete.
競.mnemonic: Twin runners frozen at the same stride — きそう. 競争 is the photo finish; 競馬 adds horses.

lesson_examples.jp: ふたりで　競（きそ）います。
まいにち　競（きそ）う。

共.etymology: Pictograph: two hands raising one object together — jointly: together, shared.
共.mnemonic: Four hands, one load, lifted level — とも. 共通, 共同: whatever needs more hands than yours.

lesson_examples.jp: ともだちと　共（とも）に　あるきます。
lesson_examples.en: I walk together with my friends.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　共働（ともばたら）きです。

協.etymology: Compound ideograph: ten (十) + three strengths (力×3) — many muscles pulling as one: cooperation.
協.mnemonic: Three biceps bolted to one crossbeam — キョウ. 協力: the kanji is literally a tug-of-war team.

lesson_examples.jp: みんなで　協力（きょうりょく）します。
これは　協議（きょうぎ）です。

極.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 亟 (phonetic キョク) — the ridgepole, highest timber of the house: the utmost point, the pole.
極.mnemonic: The one beam nothing sits above — きわめる. 北極 hangs the planet on it; 極めて pushes any adjective to the rafter.

lesson_examples.jp: 極（きわ）めて　だいじな　ことです。
lesson_examples.en: It is an extremely important matter.

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　極（きわ）める。

訓.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 川 'stream' (phonetic クン) — teaching that flows downhill from master to pupil: instruction; the native Japanese reading 'taught onto' each kanji.
訓.mnemonic: Words channeled like water down a course — クン. Every kanji you learn drinks from two streams: 音 and 訓.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　教訓（きょうくん）です。
これは　訓練（くんれん）です。

群.etymology: Phono-semantic: 君 'lord' (phonetic グン) + sheep (羊) — the lord's sheep moving as one: a flock, a crowd.
群.mnemonic: Where the shepherd-lord walks, the wool follows in a single blob — むれ. 群馬: a whole prefecture of herds.

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　群（む）れる。
これは　抜群（ばつぐん）です。

軍.etymology: Compound ideograph: chariots (車) drawn into a covered ring (冖) — the encircled war-camp: army.
軍.mnemonic: Wagons circled tight under one canopy — グン. 軍手, army gloves: the war-camp's one export to your toolbox.

lesson_examples.jp: むかしの　軍（ぐん）の　あとが　のこる。
lesson_examples.en: Traces of the old army remain.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　軍事（ぐんじ）です。

景.etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 京 'capital' (phonetic ケイ) — sunlight over the capital's towers: a fine view, scenery.
景.mnemonic: Morning light hitting the skyline: postcard weather — ケイ. 景色 is the view; 夜景 the same city after dark.

lesson_examples.jp: 山（やま）の　上（うえ）の　景色（けしき）は　さいこうです。
lesson_examples.en: The view from the mountaintop is superb.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　背景（はいけい）です。

芸.etymology: Simplified from 藝, originally a figure kneeling to plant a seedling — the cultivated skill: art, craft, performance.
芸.mnemonic: Planting done so precisely it counts as performance — ゲイ. 芸術 hangs in museums; 芸人 does it on television.

lesson_examples.jp: あたらしい　芸（げい）を　みせます。
これは　芸（げい）です。

欠.etymology: Pictograph: a person with mouth gaping wide — the open hole; in Japanese, what's missing: lack, absence.
欠.mnemonic: A yawn is a hole in your face; 欠 is a hole in the roster — かける. 欠席: the empty chair kanji.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　会議（かいぎ）を　欠席（けっせき）　した。
まいにち　欠（か）く。

結.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 吉 (phonetic ケツ) — the auspicious knot: to tie, join, conclude.
結.mnemonic: Tie the lucky knot and it holds — むすぶ. 結婚 ties people; 結果 is where any thread ends up.

lesson_examples.jp: 娘（むすめ）が　6　月（つき）に　結婚（けっこん）　します。
lesson_examples.en: My daughter is getting married in June.

lesson_examples.jp: 娘（むすめ）は　6　月（つき）に　結婚（けっこん）　します。
lesson_examples.en: My daughter is getting married in June.

健.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 建 'build' (phonetic ケン) — a person built sound and standing firm: healthy, robust.
健.mnemonic: A body with good architecture — ケン. 健康: the building inspection you pass by sleeping and eating well.

lesson_examples.jp: 健康（けんこう）が　いちばんです。
これは　健在（けんざい）です。

固.etymology: Phono-semantic: enclosure (囗) + 古 'old' (phonetic コ) — what has sat walled-in and aged: hardened, firm.
固.mnemonic: Something old sealed in a box until it sets like concrete — かたい. 固い約束: a promise past its bending date.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　頭（あたま）が　固（かた）い。
トムって　頑固（がんこ）だと　思（おも）う。

候.etymology: Compound: a person (亻) posted to watch and attend — reading the signs of sky and season: climate, symptoms, attendance.
候.mnemonic: The lookout notes wind, clouds, mood of the sky — コウ. 天候: the sentry's daily report; 気候: his yearly one.

lesson_examples.jp: 気候（きこう）が いいです。
これは　兆候（ちょうこう）です。

康.etymology: Origin read as grain threshed in abundance (husks flying below the frame) — plenty, hence ease and well-being.
康.mnemonic: The barn full, the chaff dancing, nothing to fear from winter — コウ. 健康 pairs a sound frame with a full barn.

lesson_examples.jp: からだの　康（こう）を　いのります。
これは　健康（けんこう）です。

香.etymology: Compound ideograph: grain (禾) over sweetness (曰) — the smell of grain cooking sweet: fragrance, incense.
香.mnemonic: Rice on the fire, the whole house leaning toward the pot — かおり. 香水 bottles the effect.

lesson_examples.jp: はなの　香（かお）りが　します。
lesson_examples.en: I smell the scent of flowers.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　香水（こうすい）です。

差.etymology: Compound: grain hanging uneven over the workman's square — lengths that don't match: difference, discrepancy.
差.mnemonic: Hold the ruler to the stalks: no two agree — さ. 時差 is the planet failing the same inspection.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　手（て）を　差（さ）し出（だ）した。
次（つぎ）の　交差点（こうさてん）を　右（みぎ）に　曲（ま）がってください。
lesson_examples.en: Turn right at the next intersection.

最.etymology: Compound: a daring seizure (取) made under the helmet (曰) — the boldest stroke of all: the utmost, the most.
最.mnemonic: Reach in and take the top prize — もっとも, サイ. Prefix it and win any superlative: 最高, 最初, 最強.

lesson_examples.jp: トムが　最強（さいきょう）。
最近（さいきん）　何（なに）か　映画（えいが）　見（み）た？

材.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 才 'inborn stuff' (phonetic ザイ) — timber with potential in it: material.
材.mnemonic: A log already dreaming of being a beam — ザイ. 材料 is any ingredient mid-dream; 人材 does it to people.

lesson_examples.jp: いい　木材（もくざい）を　つかいます。
これは　逸材（いつざい）です。

昨.etymology: Phono-semantic: day (日) + 乍 'freshly cut' (phonetic サク) — the day just sliced off the calendar: yesterday.
昨.mnemonic: The day the blade just trimmed away, still lying there — サク. 昨日: close enough to touch, gone for good.

lesson_examples.jp: 昨日（きのう）　何時（なんじ）に　寝（ね）た？
lesson_examples.en: What time did you go to bed yesterday?

lesson_examples.jp: トムと　昨日話（きのうばなし）を　したよ。

刷.etymology: Compound: scraping a carved block clean with cloth and blade — pressing off copies: to print.
刷.mnemonic: Ink the block, wipe, press, repeat — する, サツ. 印刷: the wipe that filled the world's libraries.

lesson_examples.jp: ほんを　刷（す）ります。
これは　印刷（いんさつ）です。

察.etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 祭 'rite' (phonetic サツ) — inspecting the rite under the roof for the smallest fault: to scrutinize, to infer.
察.mnemonic: Reading the ceremony for what nobody said aloud — サツ. 警察 does it for a living; 察する is doing it kindly.

lesson_examples.jp: 警察（けいさつ）を　呼（よ）んで下（くだ）さい。
まいにち　察（さっ）する。

札.etymology: Compound: wood (木) + a hook (乚) — a thin wooden slip hung up: a tag, a card; paper money by descent.
札.mnemonic: The wooden tag swinging on its nail — ふだ. 改札 checks yours; 千円札 is the tag you'd rather keep.

lesson_examples.jp: 千円札（せんえんさつ）で　はらいます。
lesson_examples.en: I pay with a thousand-yen bill.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　札（さつ）です。

参.etymology: Pictograph read as hairpins glittering on a figure going to court — to present oneself: to visit (humbly), to participate; formal 'three'.
参.mnemonic: Dressed, pinned and sparkling: off to appear before someone — まいる. 参加 is showing up; 参りました is showing up defeated.

lesson_examples.jp: かいぎに　参（さん）かします。
lesson_examples.en: I'll take part in the meeting.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　参照（さんしょう）です。

散.etymology: Compound: meat beaten apart with a stick — knocked into pieces and strewn: to scatter, disperse.
散.mnemonic: One whack and everything flies apart — ちる. 散歩 is the peaceful version: scattering yourself around the block.

lesson_examples.jp: 誰（だれ）か　海（うみ）まで　散歩（さんぽ）に　行（い）かない？
lesson_examples.en: Anybody want to take a walk to the sea?

lesson_examples.jp: これは　散々（さんざん）です。

残.etymology: Phono-semantic: bones (歹) + 戔 'blades' (phonetic ザン) — what the blades leave on the field: the remainder; the cruelty that left it.
残.mnemonic: After everything is taken, this is what stays — のこる. 残念: the leftovers of a hope.

lesson_examples.jp: ご　一緒（いっしょ）　できなくて　残念（ざんねん）です。
lesson_examples.en: It is regrettable that I can't go with you.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　残（のこ）らずです。

司.etymology: Compound ideograph: a hand raised over a commanding mouth — the one who directs affairs: to administer.
司.mnemonic: One raised hand, one clear order — シ. 上司 gives them; 司会 directs the party with a microphone.

lesson_examples.jp: かれが　司会（しかい）を　します。
これは　寿司（すし）です。

児.etymology: Simplified from 兒: an infant with the fontanelle still open (the gap in the top) on baby legs — a newborn, a child.
児.mnemonic: Soft-skulled and wobbling but already walking — ジ. 児童 fills classrooms; 育児 fills your nights.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　幼児（ようじ）です。
これは　児童（じどう）です。

治.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 台 (phonetic ジ/チ) — mastering the rivers was the first governing; setting things right heals: to govern, to cure.
治.mnemonic: Tame the flood and you can rule anything, including a fever — おさめる, なおる. 政治 and 治療: same verb, different floods.

lesson_examples.jp: 頭（あたま）　痛（いた）い　の　治（なお）った？
風邪（かぜ）　治（なお）ってよかったね。
lesson_examples.en: I'm glad your cold is better.

辞.etymology: Simplified from 辭: the tongue (舌) and the branding needle (辛) — formal words, sharp enough to cut ties: an address; to resign.
辞.mnemonic: Words with a needle in them: the farewell speech — ジ. 辞書 collects the words; 辞める uses the needle.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　辞退（じたい）です。
これは　御辞儀（おじぎ）です。

失.etymology: Pictograph: a hand with something dropping from it — gone before the fingers close: to lose.
失.mnemonic: The exact instant it leaves your grip — うしなう. 失敗 is losing hold of the plan; 失礼 of the manners.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　気（き）を　失（うしな）った。
トムは　気（き）を　失（うしな）っている。

種.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 重 'heavy' (phonetic シュ) — the heaviest grains kept for sowing: seed; each seed its kind: species.
種.mnemonic: The fattest seeds go in the sowing jar, sorted by kind — たね. 種類: the jars, labeled.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　機種（きしゅ）です。
これは　品種（ひんしゅ）です。

周.etymology: Pictograph: a field planted thick to its borders — covering all the way around: circumference, circuit.
周.mnemonic: Plow to every edge, then walk the fence line — シュウ. 一周: one full lap of anything.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　周年（しゅうねん）です。
これは　周辺（しゅうへん）です。

祝.etymology: Compound ideograph: the speaker (兄, a mouth on legs) at the altar (ネ) — reciting the blessing: to celebrate.
祝.mnemonic: The family's voice steps up to the altar with good news — いわう. お祝い: the blessing plus an envelope.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　祝（いわ）いです。
まいにち　祝（いわ）う。

順.etymology: Compound ideograph: a head (頁) following the stream (川) — going with the current: obedient; the sequence the current makes: order.
順.mnemonic: Float head-first the way the river says — ジュン. 順番: the river arranging everyone into a queue.

lesson_examples.jp: 順番（じゅんばん）に　ならびます。
これは　手順（てじゅん）です。

初.etymology: Compound ideograph: cloth (衤) + blade (刀) — the tailor's first cut into new fabric: the very beginning.
初.mnemonic: Scissors poised over untouched cloth: no undo after this — はじめて. 最初 is that cut; 初めまして its social version.

lesson_examples.jp: その　言葉（ことば）は　初耳（はつみみ）です。
lesson_examples.en: This is the first time I've heard that word.

lesson_examples.jp: 海外（かいがい）　旅行（りょこう）は　初（はじ）めてですか？
lesson_examples.en: Is this your first trip abroad?

焼.etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 尭 'raised high' (phonetic ショウ) — flames piled high: to burn, grill, bake.
焼.mnemonic: Stack the fire and put dinner over it — やく. 焼き鳥, 焼きそば, お好み焼き: Japan's tastiest kanji.

lesson_examples.jp: 焼（や）きたての　パンの　匂（にお）いが　好（す）きです。
lesson_examples.en: I like the smell of fresh bread.

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　焼（や）く。

照.etymology: Phono-semantic: 昭 'shining' (phonetic ショウ) + fire (灬) — light cast down onto: to illuminate.
照.mnemonic: Floodlights plus footlights: everything visible — てる. 照れる is being lit up when you'd rather not be: blushing.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　参照（さんしょう）です。
まいにち　照（て）る。

省.etymology: Compound ideograph: narrowing (少) the eye (目) — close inspection: to reflect (反省); to trim what inspection finds useless: omit; the inspecting office: ministry.
省.mnemonic: Squint hard at it: examine, then cut the excess — かえりみる, はぶく. The 省 ministries were born squinting at budgets.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　反省（はんせい）です。
これは　帰省（きせい）です。

笑.etymology: Classically read: bamboo (⺮) swaying like a person doubled over (夭) — the whole grove shaking: to laugh.
笑.mnemonic: Wind hits the grove and every stalk cracks up — わらう. 笑顔: the face doing what bamboo does.

lesson_examples.jp: 何（なに）　笑（わら）ってんの？
トムが　笑（わら）っ　てる。

城.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 成 'completed' (phonetic ジョウ) — earthworks raised to completion: a castle.
城.mnemonic: Dirt piled until it becomes (成) power — しろ. 大阪城: the hill that means business.

lesson_examples.jp: 古（ふる）い　城（しろ）を　みに　いきます。
lesson_examples.en: We go to see the old castle.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　城（しろ）です。

信.etymology: Compound ideograph: a person (亻) standing by their word (言) — word and person aligned: trust, faith; a message so backed.
信.mnemonic: Where the person and the promise overlap — シン. 信じる is betting on that overlap; 自信 betting on your own.

lesson_examples.jp: 信号（しんごう）　青（あお）に　なったよ。
幽霊（ゆうれい）って　信（しん）じますか？

臣.etymology: Pictograph: an eye turned down in a bowed head — the posture of service: retainer, minister.
臣.mnemonic: The eye that never meets the throne's — シン. 大臣: the deepest bow with the biggest office.

lesson_examples.jp: おうの　臣（しん）です。
これは　大臣（だいじん）です。

成.etymology: Compound: work driven to its end under the halberd's authority — brought to completion: to become, to accomplish.
成.mnemonic: The final nail goes in and the thing exists — なる. 成功 is the nail landing; 成る the moment before.

lesson_examples.jp: 大（だい）　賛成（さんせい）です。
トムは　銃（じゅう）　規制（きせい）に　賛成（さんせい）だ。
lesson_examples.en: Tom is in favor of gun control.

清.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 青 'blue-green' (phonetic セイ) — water so clean it shows blue: pure, clear.
清.mnemonic: Water you can read a book through — きよい. 清水寺: the temple named for exactly that spring.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　清々（せいせい）です。
これは　清算（せいさん）です。

静.etymology: Phono-semantic: 青 (phonetic セイ) + 争 'struggle' — the struggle settled into blue calm: quiet, still.
静.mnemonic: The fight ends and blue silence pours back in — しずか. 静かに: what the librarian's whole body says.

lesson_examples.jp: 静（しず）かに！
ちょっと　静（しず）かに　してください。

席.etymology: Compound: a cloth mat (巾) spread under the canopy (广) — one's place on the matting: a seat.
席.mnemonic: Your square of cloth in the pavilion: reserved — セキ. 出席 is putting your body on it; 欠席 leaving it cold.

lesson_examples.jp: 禁煙（きんえん）　席（せき）は　ありますか。
lesson_examples.en: Do you have a non-smoking section?

lesson_examples.jp: この　席（せき）　空（あ）いてますか？

積.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 責 'levy' (phonetic セキ) — the tax-grain stacked sack on sack: to pile up; the pile measured: volume, product.
積.mnemonic: Sacks climbing the granary wall, tallied as they rise — つむ. 積極的: piling effort the same way.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　山積（やまず）みです。
まいにち　見積（みつ）もる。

折.etymology: Compound ideograph: hand (扌) + axe (斤) — snapping green wood over the knee or blade: to break; the gentler bend: to fold.
折.mnemonic: Crease it like the axe would cut it — おる. 折り紙 folds paper; 骨折 folds what shouldn't fold.

lesson_examples.jp: かみを　折（お）って　つるを　つくります。
lesson_examples.en: I fold paper into a crane.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　時折（ときおり）です。

節.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 即 (phonetic セツ) — the bamboo's joints: nodes; the year's joints: seasons; joints hold things in check: moderation.
節.mnemonic: Bamboo grows in verses with a knuckle between each — ふし. 季節 are the year's knuckles; 節約 is gripping at one.

lesson_examples.jp: 電気（でんき）を　節約（せつやく）します。
これは　調節（ちょうせつ）です。

戦.etymology: Phono-semantic: 単 (phonetic セン — originally a forked hunting weapon) + 戈 'halberd' — weapons against weapons: war.
戦.mnemonic: Two arsenals in one character, nothing else in it — たたかう. 戦争 doubles the word; history keeps doubling the kanji.

lesson_examples.jp: フランス語（ご）の　文法（ぶんぽう）に　苦戦（くせん）　しています。
これは　作戦（さくせん）です。

浅.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 戔 'pared down' (phonetic セン) — water shaved thin: shallow.
浅.mnemonic: Blades planed the river down to ankle depth — あさい. 浅草: the 'shallow grass' district, deep only in crowds.

lesson_examples.jp: この　かわは　浅（あさ）いです。
これは　浅（あさ）ましいです。

選.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 巽 (phonetic セン) — candidates presented and one sent forward: to select, elect.
選.mnemonic: The line walks past; you point at one — えらぶ. 選手 is the chosen athlete; 選挙 the national pointing.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　選択（せんたく）　した。
これは　抽選（ちゅうせん）です。

然.etymology: Originally 'to burn' (meat + dog + fire — the root of 燃); borrowed since antiquity for 'thus, so, in that manner'.
然.mnemonic: The fire says: that's just how it is — ゼン. 自然 is the world being so by itself; 全然 is 'not so at all'.

lesson_examples.jp: とつ然（ぜん）、あめが　ふりました。
これは　然（さ）もです。

争.etymology: Compound ideograph: two hands wrenching one hooked object in opposite directions — to contend, dispute.
争.mnemonic: Both grips on the same handle, neither letting go — あらそう. 戦争 is this kanji armed; 競争 this kanji in sneakers.

lesson_examples.jp: もう　争（あらそ）わないで。
これは　紛争（ふんそう）です。

側.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 則 (phonetic ソク) — the person stationed beside: the side, the flank.
側.mnemonic: Always at your elbow, by the rules — がわ. 右側, 向こう側: pick your flank.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　右側（みぎがわ）です。
これは　内側（うちがわ）です。

束.etymology: Pictograph: sticks cinched with a band around the middle — a bundle, a sheaf.
束.mnemonic: Firewood strapped tight through the waist — たば. 約束 ties two people the same way: a promise.

lesson_examples.jp: 花束（はなたば）を　おくります。
lesson_examples.en: I give a bouquet of flowers.

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　束（たば）ねる。

続.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 續): thread (糸) + a phonetic now written 売 — thread joined to thread without end: to continue.
続.mnemonic: Splice the new spool to the old before it runs out — つづく. Every cliffhanger ends with this kanji: 続く.

lesson_examples.jp: 話（はなし）の　続（つづ）きは　明日（あした）に　します。
lesson_examples.en: I'll tell you the rest of the story tomorrow.

lesson_examples.jp: バレエ　続（つづ）け　てればよかった。

卒.etymology: Originally the marked garment of conscript soldiers — the lowest rank; serving one's full term gave 'to finish': graduation.
卒.mnemonic: Uniforms in rows, the term served out — ソツ. 卒業 is handing the uniform back with a diploma.

lesson_examples.jp: 学校（がっこう）を　卒業（そつぎょう）します。
これは　新卒（しんそつ）です。

孫.etymology: Compound ideograph: child (子) + connecting thread (系) — the child one thread further down the line: grandchild.
孫.mnemonic: Your child's child, one more knot along the family rope — まご. The thread does the explaining.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　孫（まご）です。
孫（まご）が　すきです。

帯.etymology: Pictograph: a sash with ornaments hanging over the skirt cloth — the belt; what a belt does: to carry on one; a belt of territory: zone.
帯.mnemonic: The obi cinched, charms dangling — おび. 熱帯 is the planet's hot waistband; 携帯 what you carry tucked in yours.

lesson_examples.jp: 今（こん）　携帯（けいたい）　持（も）っ　てる？
lesson_examples.en: Do you have a cell phone with you?

lesson_examples.jp: 携帯（けいたい）の　番号（ばんごう）を　教（おし）えていただけませんか？
lesson_examples.en: Can I have your cellphone number?

達.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 羍 (phonetic タツ — a lamb delivered without difficulty) — arriving without obstruction: to attain, reach.
達.mnemonic: Delivery without a single snag — タツ. 友達: the people your road reliably reaches; 配達: the parcel version.

lesson_examples.jp: 中国人（ちゅうごくじん）の　友達（ともだち）は　何人（なんにん）　いますか？
lesson_examples.en: How many Chinese friends do you have?

lesson_examples.jp: カナダ人（じん）の　友達（ともだち）は　何人（なんにん）　いますか？
lesson_examples.en: How many Canadian friends do you have?

単.etymology: Simplified from 單: a forked hunting weapon or shield — one piece of equipment, one man: single, simple.
単.mnemonic: One tool, no attachments — タン. 簡単 is the two-kanji hymn to it; 単語: words taken one at a time.

lesson_examples.jp: この　単語（たんご）が　分（わ）かりません。
単語帳（たんごちょう）　作（つく）る　のって　意味（いみ）　あると　思（おも）う？
lesson_examples.en: Do you figure there's any reason to make a vocabulary book?

置.etymology: Phono-semantic: net (罒) + 直 'straight' (phonetic チ) — the net set out straight and left: to place, to set down.
置.mnemonic: Lay it flat, square it, walk away — おく. 位置: where things got 置いた and stayed.

lesson_examples.jp: その　箱（はこ）の　上（うえ）に、何（なに）も　置（お）かないで下（くだ）さい。
lesson_examples.en: Don't put anything on top of the box.

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　一目置（いちもく）く。

仲.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 中 'middle' (phonetic チュウ) — the person in the middle of two others: go-between; the state between people: terms.
仲.mnemonic: Standing exactly between two friends, keeping them friends — なか. 仲がいい: the middle is warm.

lesson_examples.jp: クラスに　仲（なか）　いい　人（ひと）　いる？
lesson_examples.en: Do you have friends in your class?

lesson_examples.jp: これは　仲（なか）です。

兆.etymology: Pictograph: the cracks radiating across a heated tortoise shell — read by diviners as signs: portent; borrowed for the enormous number 10¹².
兆.mnemonic: The shell splits into a map of the future — きざし. Big enough news to need the number: 一兆.

lesson_examples.jp: いい　兆（きざ）しです。
これは　兆（きざ）しです。

底.etymology: Phono-semantic: building (广) + 氐 'base' (phonetic テイ) — the building's lowest point: the bottom.
底.mnemonic: Below the floor, below the footing: the true floor — そこ. 海底: the one basement the planet has.

lesson_examples.jp: 心（こころ）の　底（そこ）から　同意（どうい）　します。
これは　心底（しんそこ）です。

的.etymology: Phono-semantic: white (白) + 勺 (phonetic テキ) — the white disc of the target: bullseye; grammaticalized into the adjective-making suffix 〜的.
的.mnemonic: The white circle everything aims at — まと. Attach 〜的 and any noun starts aiming: 目的, 具体的.

lesson_examples.jp: 私（わたし）、基本的（きほんてき）に　一人（いちにん）で　いる　方（ほう）が　好（す）きな　んです。
lesson_examples.en: I basically prefer being by myself.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　良心的（りょうしんてき）です。

伝.etymology: Simplified from 傳: person (亻) + a phonetic — the relay rider passing the message on: to transmit, hand down.
伝.mnemonic: One person breathes it (云) to the next — つたえる. 手伝う: passing your hands along too.

lesson_examples.jp: 手伝（てつだ）おうか？
lesson_examples.en: Do you want me to help?

lesson_examples.jp: お手伝（てつだ）い　しましょうか？

徒.etymology: Compound: road (彳) + going (走) — traveling on foot; those who walk behind a master: followers, students.
徒.mnemonic: No horse, no cart: the ones walking behind — ト. 生徒: students, still on foot behind the teacher.

lesson_examples.jp: 徒（いたずら）に　しました。
これは　生徒（せいと）です。

努.etymology: Phono-semantic: 奴 'slave' (phonetic ド) + strength (力) — working like one owned: to strive, exert.
努.mnemonic: Muscle spent as if you had no choice — つとめる. 努力: choosing that grind voluntarily.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　努（つと）めてです。
まいにち　努（つと）める。

灯.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 燈): fire (火) + 丁 (phonetic トウ) — fire fixed on a stand: the lamp.
灯.mnemonic: A flame nailed in place so it can't wander — ひ, トウ. 電灯: the nail is now a socket.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　灯（ひ）です。
これは　灯（ともしび）です。

熱.etymology: Phono-semantic: 埶 (phonetic ネツ) + fire (灬) — fire tended below: heat; the body's own fire: fever.
熱.mnemonic: Flames under everything you care about — あつい. 熱がある: the fire moved indoors; 熱心: the useful kind.

lesson_examples.jp: 熱（ねつ）が　ある　んです。
熱（ねつ）　計（はか）ってみたら？
lesson_examples.en: Why don't you take your temperature?

念.etymology: Phono-semantic: 今 'now' (phonetic ネン) + heart (心) — the heart holding this very moment: a fixed thought, a wish.
念.mnemonic: The heart pressing 'save' on the present — ネン. 残念: the save that failed; 記念: the one that took.

lesson_examples.jp: ご　一緒（いっしょ）　できなくて　残念（ざんねん）です。
lesson_examples.en: It is regrettable that I can't go with you.

lesson_examples.jp: 念（ねん）の　ため　傘（かさ）　持（も）って行（い）ったら？
lesson_examples.en: Just to be on the safe side, why don't you take an umbrella with you?

敗.etymology: Phono-semantic: 貝 'treasure' (phonetic ハイ) + 攵 'strike' — the treasure smashed: ruin, defeat.
敗.mnemonic: The stick comes down on the shell: what you built, broken — やぶれる. 失敗 pairs losing grip with the crack.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　禁煙（きんえん）に　失敗（しっぱい）　した。
lesson_examples.en: Tom was not able to quit smoking.

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　敗（やぶ）れる。

飛.etymology: Pictograph: a bird climbing with both wings beating and neck stretched — to fly.
飛.mnemonic: Mid-takeoff, feathers everywhere — とぶ. 飛行機 borrowed the wings; the kanji still owns them.

lesson_examples.jp: とりが　飛（と）んで　いきます。
まいにち　飛（と）ぶ。

必.etymology: Originally the bound haft of a weapon — 'fixed firm'; the shape later read as a heart pinned by a stroke: invariably, without fail.
必.mnemonic: A heart with a stake through it cannot change its mind — かならず. 必要, 必死: needs and resolves at 100%.

lesson_examples.jp: その　必要（ひつよう）は　ありません。
トムは　謝（あやま）る　必要（ひつよう）　ないよ。
lesson_examples.en: You don't have to apologize, Tom.

標.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 票 (phonetic ヒョウ) — the marker at the treetop, visible far off: a sign, a mark.
標.mnemonic: The flag lashed to the tallest branch: aim here — ヒョウ. 目標: the branch your eyes keep returning to.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　目標（もくひょう）です。
これは　標（しるべ）です。

付.etymology: Compound ideograph: a hand (寸) pressing something onto a person (亻) — to hand over, to attach.
付.mnemonic: Pressed into your palm until it sticks — つける. 受付 attaches visitors to the building; 気を付けて attaches care to you.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　凧（たこ）に　糸（いと）を　付（つ）けた。
lesson_examples.en: Tom attached the string to the kite.

lesson_examples.jp: この　付近（ふきん）は　駐車（ちゅうしゃ）　禁止（きんし）です。

夫.etymology: Pictograph: a grown man (大) with the pin of adulthood through his topknot (一) — a full-grown man: husband.
夫.mnemonic: The pin through the hair says: adult, married, responsible — おっと. 大丈夫 stacks three sturdy kanji into 'it's fine'.

lesson_examples.jp: トム、大丈夫（だいじょうぶ）？
もう　大丈夫（だいじょうぶ）です。

富.etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 畐 'jar full to the brim' (phonetic フ) — abundance under the roof: wealth.
富.mnemonic: The pantry jar that never empties — とみ. 富士山: the mountain named like a full house.

lesson_examples.jp: 富士山（ふじさん）に　登（のぼ）った　ことは　ありますか？
lesson_examples.en: Have you ever climbed Mt. Fuji?

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　富（と）む。

府.etymology: Phono-semantic: building (广) + 付 (phonetic フ) — the government repository where documents attach: the seat of administration; today Osaka-fu, Kyoto-fu.
府.mnemonic: The building all the paperwork sticks to — フ. 政府: the biggest flypaper of all.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　政府（せいふ）です。
政府（せいふ）が　すきです。

副.etymology: Phono-semantic: 畐 'full vessel' (phonetic フク) + blade (刂) — the vessel split to make a matching second: duplicate, deputy: vice-.
副.mnemonic: Slice the jar's contents into a twin copy — フク. 副社長: the copy that signs when the original is away.

lesson_examples.jp: 副（ふく）かいちょうです。
これは　副作用（ふくさよう）です。

兵.etymology: Compound ideograph: an axe (斤) gripped in both hands — the armed man: soldier, troops.
兵.mnemonic: Both fists on the axe-haft, ready — ヘイ. 兵士: the kanji is already at attention.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　兵（つわもの）です。
兵（つわもの）が　すきです。

変.etymology: Simplified from 變: tangled threads beaten (攵) into a new state — to change; what changed too far: strange.
変.mnemonic: Beat the knot until it becomes something else — かわる; if it comes out weird, that's 変 too — へん.

lesson_examples.jp: 変（へん）な　こと　言（い）うなよ。
相変（あいか）わらず　忙（いそが）しいの？

辺.etymology: Simplified from 邊: movement (辶) + a tall phonetic — where the road runs out: the edge, the vicinity.
辺.mnemonic: Walk until the map frays — あたり, ベ. この辺: 'around here', measured in strolls.

lesson_examples.jp: この　辺（あた）りに　ATMは　ありますか？
lesson_examples.en: Is there an ATM around here?

lesson_examples.jp: これは　辺（あた）りです。

包.etymology: Pictograph: a body curled around a fetus (勹 around 巳) — the original wrapping: to wrap, envelop.
包.mnemonic: Curled protectively around what's inside — つつむ. 包丁, oddly, is the kitchen knife: what unwraps dinner.

lesson_examples.jp: プレゼントを　包（つつ）みます。
まいにち　包（くる）む。

法.etymology: Compound: water (氵) + 去 — law like water: it finds its level everywhere it goes; the leveled way of doing: method.
法.mnemonic: Water settles perfectly flat, no exceptions granted — ホウ. 方法 is the路 of doing; 法律 the water applied to people.

lesson_examples.jp: この　方法（ほうほう）なら　きっと　うまく　いきます。
lesson_examples.en: This method is sure to work.

lesson_examples.jp: フランス語（ご）の　文法（ぶんぽう）に　苦戦（くせん）　しています。

望.etymology: Compound: a figure standing tall, gazing at the moon (月) for what is absent (亡) — longing, hope; the moon gazed at fullest: full moon.
望.mnemonic: On tiptoe, eyes on the full moon, wanting — のぞむ. 希望: hope with its neck craned.

lesson_examples.jp: 希望（きぼう）を　もって　すすみます。
これは　有望（ゆうぼう）です。

末.etymology: Ideograph: a tree (木) with a long stroke marking its topmost branch — the far end: the tip, the close. Mirror of 本, which marks the root.
末.mnemonic: The mark at the treetop: as far as it goes — すえ. 週末: the branch-tip of the week.

lesson_examples.jp: 今週末（こんしゅうまつ）は　暇（ひま）？
今週末（こんしゅうまつ）　空（あ）い　てる？

満.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 㒼 (phonetic マン) — filled level to the rim: full, complete.
満.mnemonic: Poured to the brim without one drop over — みちる. 満員: a train filled by the same principle.

lesson_examples.jp: 満（まん）　タンに　してください。
チューリップは　今（いま）が　満開（まんかい）です。
lesson_examples.en: Tulips are in full bloom now.

未.etymology: Ideograph: a tree (木) whose top branch is still short — growth unfinished: not yet. Twin of 末, where the branch has arrived.
未.mnemonic: The upper branch hasn't caught up: unfinished — ミ. 未来: the not-yet, scheduled; 未満: not yet reaching the line.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　未婚（みこん）だった。
未（み）　就学（しゅうがく）の　お子様（こさま）は　入場（にゅうじょう）　無料（むりょう）です。
lesson_examples.en: Admission is free for preschool children.

無.etymology: Pictograph of a dancer with tasseled sleeves, borrowed since the oracle bones for 'there is not' — the dots below are the deformed legs, not fire.
無.mnemonic: The dance ends, the stage is bare — ない, ム. 無料 is 'nothing owed'; 無理 'no way there'.

lesson_examples.jp: 無理（むり）　しないでね。
トムは　政治（せいじ）に　無（む）　関心（かんしん）だ。
lesson_examples.en: Tom is not interested in politics.

約.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 勺 (phonetic ヤク) — a cord knotted at the agreed measure: a promise; measured, not exact: approximately.
約.mnemonic: Tie the knot where you both agreed — ヤク. 約束 doubles the binding; 約3時間 keeps the knot loose.

lesson_examples.jp: 3じに　あう　約束（やくそく）です。
lesson_examples.en: We promised to meet at three.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　倹約（けんやく）です。

勇.etymology: Phono-semantic: 甬 (phonetic ユウ) + strength (力) — strength welling up and through: courage.
勇.mnemonic: The strength that moves before fear finishes talking — いさむ. 勇気: the kanji that goes first.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　勇（いさ）ましいです。
これは　勇気（ゆうき）です。

要.etymology: Pictograph: hands gripping a waist (the root of 腰) — the body's pivot point: the essential; what the essential does: need.
要.mnemonic: Everything above and below turns on the waist — いる, ヨウ. 必要: pinned and pivotal at once.

lesson_examples.jp: その　必要（ひつよう）は　ありません。
トムは　謝（あやま）る　必要（ひつよう）　ないよ。
lesson_examples.en: You don't have to apologize, Tom.

浴.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 谷 'valley' (phonetic ヨク) — stepping into the valley stream: to bathe, to bask.
浴.mnemonic: The mountain pours a private shower into the ravine — あびる. 浴衣: what you wear walking back from it.

lesson_examples.jp: あさひを　浴（あ）びます。
lesson_examples.en: I bathe in the morning sun.

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　浴（あ）びる。

利.etymology: Compound ideograph: grain (禾) + blade (刂) — the sickle slicing clean through the harvest: sharp; what the harvest yields: profit, advantage.
利.mnemonic: A sharp edge cuts more grain per swing — リ. 便利 is life with good edges; 利益 the grain they bring in.

lesson_examples.jp: はなが　利（き）きます。
lesson_examples.en: I have a good sense of smell.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　利子（りし）です。

陸.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 坴 (phonetic リク) — high dry ground: land, as opposed to sea.
陸.mnemonic: Dirt piled on dirt until the sea gives up — リク. 大陸: the pile at continental scale; 陸上: sports on it.

lesson_examples.jp: 陸（りく）に　あがります。
これは　大陸（たいりく）です。

良.etymology: Pictograph: a sifting device separating fine grain from chaff — what passes the sieve: good.
良.mnemonic: Only the best grains make it through — よい. 良い is the sieve's verdict; 奈良 wears it in its name.

lesson_examples.jp: 天気（てんき）が　良（よ）かったら　行（い）きます。
lesson_examples.en: I'll go if the weather's good.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　良心的（りょうしんてき）です。

量.etymology: Pictograph: a grain sack with a measuring opening at the top — to measure out: quantity.
量.mnemonic: The sack tells you how much by the mouthful — リョウ. 大量, measure overflowing; 測量, measuring gone professional.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　減量（げんりょう）です。
これは　感無量（かんむりょう）です。

輪.etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 侖 'ordered arrangement' (phonetic リン) — spokes set in perfect order: the wheel; any ring.
輪.mnemonic: Spokes filed in a circle like books on a round shelf — わ. 指輪 for the finger, 五輪 for the Olympics.

lesson_examples.jp: 花（はな）の　輪（わ）を　つくります。
lesson_examples.en: We make a ring of flowers.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　指輪（ゆびわ）です。

類.etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic built of rice and dog + head (頁) — things whose 'heads' resemble each other, sorted into heaps: kind, sort.
類.mnemonic: Sort the pantry by lookalikes: this heap, that heap — ルイ. 種類: heaps with labels; 書類: heaps with staples.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　めずらしい　類（るい）です。
これは　分類（ぶんるい）です。

令.etymology: Compound ideograph: the assembly summoned (亼) and one kneeling (卩) to receive the word — a command, a decree.
令.mnemonic: The scroll read from the steps, everyone on one knee — レイ. 命令: orders with your name on them; 令和: an era named by one.

lesson_examples.jp: 命令（めいれい）に　したがいます。
これは　命令（めいれい）です。

例.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 列 'row' (phonetic レイ) — people lined up as precedents: an example, a custom.
例.mnemonic: Pull one person out of the line to show the rest — たとえば. 例えば: the kanji clearing its throat before a for-instance.

lesson_examples.jp: 例（たと）えば、こんな　ふうに。
これは　例（れい）のです。

冷.etymology: Phono-semantic: ice (冫) + 令 (phonetic レイ) — cold as a decree: chilled, cool (of things and of people).
冷.mnemonic: Orders delivered over ice — つめたい. 冷蔵庫 keeps the beer 冷たい; some replies come out of the same drawer.

lesson_examples.jp: 冷蔵庫（れいぞうこ）の　中（なか）の　物（もの）は、何（なに）でも　御（ご）　自由（じゆう）に　召（め）し上（あ）がってください。
lesson_examples.en: Please feel free to have anything in the fridge.

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　冷（ひ）やかす。

連.etymology: Compound ideograph: carts (車) moving (辶) coupled in a train — linked one to the next: to connect, to take along.
連.mnemonic: Wagon hitched to wagon, all rolling together — つれる. 連絡 links people; 連休 links holidays.

lesson_examples.jp: 連絡（れんらく）　して下（くだ）さい。
トムを　連（つ）れてきて。

労.etymology: Simplified from 勞: fires blazing above strength (力) — strength burned through the night: labor, toil.
労.mnemonic: Working by torchlight until the fuel is you — ロウ. 苦労 is the invoice; ご苦労さま the receipt.

lesson_examples.jp: 苦労（くろう）が　むくわれました。
まいにち　労（いたわ）る。

老.etymology: Pictograph: an elder with long hair bent over a cane — old age.
老.mnemonic: Hair grown past the shoulders, weight on the stick — おいる. 老人: the kanji leaning as it walks.

lesson_examples.jp: 老（お）いを　かんじます。
これは　老後（ろうご）です。

録.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 彔 (phonetic ロク) — cut into bronze so it cannot be unsaid: to record.
録.mnemonic: Engraved, not jotted — ロク. 記録 outlives the writer; 録音 does it to sound.

lesson_examples.jp: こえを　録音（ろくおん）します。
これは　録画（ろくが）です。

井.etymology: Pictograph: the wooden frame around a well mouth.
井.mnemonic: Four beams crossed over the water — い. 天井: the ceiling, the room's well-frame overhead.

lesson_examples.jp: 井戸（いど）の　みずは　つめたい。
これは　井戸（いど）です。

沖.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 中 (phonetic チュウ) — out in the middle water: the offing.
沖.mnemonic: Where the land stops mattering — おき. 沖縄: the islands out in the middle.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　沖縄（おきなわ）です。
これは　沖（おき）です。

芽.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 牙 'tusk' (phonetic ガ) — the shoot breaking soil like a tusk: a bud.
芽.mnemonic: Spring's first fang — め. 芽が出る: talent and tulips, same verb.

lesson_examples.jp: たねから　芽（め）が　でた。
これは　芽（め）です。

賀.etymology: Phono-semantic: 加 (phonetic ガ) + 貝 — gifts added to good news: felicitation.
賀.mnemonic: Joy plus an envelope of cash — ガ. 年賀状: congratulations, postmarked January 1st.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　年賀状（ねんがじょう）です。
年賀状（ねんがじょう）が　すきです。

街.etymology: Phono-semantic: crossroads (行) + 圭 (phonetic ガイ) — the built-up streets between: boulevard, quarter.
街.mnemonic: The road with shops sewn to both edges — まち. 商店街: the arcade of it.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　街（まち）を　離（はな）れた。
ボストンは　素晴（すば）らしい　街（まち）です。

潟.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 舄 (phonetic セキ) — shallow tidal flats: a lagoon.
潟.mnemonic: Water that can't decide if it's land — かた. 新潟: the new lagoon, now a prefecture.

lesson_examples.jp: 干潟（ひがた）で　鳥（とり）を　見（み）ます。
lesson_examples.en: I watch birds on the tidal flat.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　潟（かた）です。

岐.etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 支 'branch' (phonetic キ) — where the mountain path splits: a fork.
岐.mnemonic: The trail forks at the ridge — キ. 岐阜: the prefecture at the fork; 分岐点: life's version.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　岐路（きろ）です。
lesson_examples.en: This is a fork in the road.

lesson_examples.jp: 岐路（きろ）が　すきです。
lesson_examples.en: I like a fork in the road.

旗.etymology: Phono-semantic: the streaming-banner radical + 其 (phonetic キ) — the standard raised: a flag.
旗.mnemonic: The pole, the wind, the claim — はた. 国旗: identity on fabric.

lesson_examples.jp: ふねの　旗（はた）が　なびく。
これは　国旗（こっき）です。

挙.etymology: Simplified from 擧: many hands lifting together — to raise up, cite, hold (an event).
挙.mnemonic: Hands up, all at once — あげる. 選挙: raising hands nationally.

lesson_examples.jp: 手（て）を　挙（あ）げて　ください。
まいにち　挙（あ）げる。

鏡.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 竟 (phonetic キョウ) — polished bronze that gives back the face: a mirror.
鏡.mnemonic: Metal that learned your face — かがみ. 眼鏡: mirrors for the eyes, めがね.

lesson_examples.jp: 鏡（かがみ）を　みて　みだしなみ。
これは　鏡（かがみ）です。

熊.etymology: Compound: 能 (originally the bear pictograph) with fire-dots restored as paws — the bear itself.
熊.mnemonic: 能 went into grammar, so the animal grew paws — くま. 熊本: bear country, officially.

lesson_examples.jp: 山（やま）で　熊（くま）に　ちゅうい。
lesson_examples.en: Beware of bears in the mountains.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　熊（くま）です。

郡.etymology: Phono-semantic: 君 (phonetic グン) + city (阝) — the lord's administrative district: a county.
郡.mnemonic: The lord's slice of the map — グン. Rural addresses still carry it.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　郡（こおり）です。
郡（こおり）が　すきです。

径.etymology: Phono-semantic: path (彳) + 巠 (phonetic ケイ) — the direct footpath; geometry's shortest crossing: diameter.
径.mnemonic: The shortcut straight through the circle — ケイ. 直径: the honest path.

lesson_examples.jp: 円（えん）の　直径（ちょっけい）を　はかります。
これは　径（みち）です。

功.etymology: Phono-semantic: 工 (phonetic コウ) + strength (力) — work backed by muscle: merit, service.
功.mnemonic: Craft times effort equals credit — コウ. 成功: the receipt for both.

lesson_examples.jp: 成功（せいこう）を　いのる！
これは　成功（せいこう）です。

佐.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 左 (phonetic サ) — the person at your left hand: an aide.
佐.mnemonic: The left-hand man — サ. 佐藤: Japan's most common surname carries him.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　補佐（ほさ）です。
補佐（ほさ）が　すきです。

崎.etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 奇 (phonetic キ) — the mountain jutting oddly into the sea: a cape.
崎.mnemonic: The cliff that wouldn't stop at the shore — さき. 長崎, 宮崎: capes turned cities.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　長崎（ながさき）です。
これは　崎（さき）です。

氏.etymology: Pictograph read as a root or a ladle — the family stem: clan, surname; the neutral honorific 〜氏.
氏.mnemonic: The root every family tree stands on — シ. 田中氏: Mr. Tanaka, rootstock included.

lesson_examples.jp: 彼氏（かれし）　できたら　教（おし）えてね。
lesson_examples.en: Tell me if you find a boyfriend.

lesson_examples.jp: 新（あたら）しい　彼氏（かれし）　できたら　教（おし）えてね。
lesson_examples.en: Tell me if you find a new boyfriend.

滋.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 茲 (phonetic ジ) — waters that make things thrive: nourishing.
滋.mnemonic: The water plants would order by name — ジ. 滋養: nutrition, poetically.

lesson_examples.jp: 滋養（じよう）の　ある　食（た）べ物（もの）です。
これは　滋養（じよう）です。

鹿.etymology: Pictograph: a deer — antlers, body and legs still visible in the strokes.
鹿.mnemonic: Antlers under a cliff-shaped sky — しか. 鹿児島: deer island; Nara: their kingdom.

lesson_examples.jp: 男子（だんし）って　みんな　馬鹿（ばか）だよね。
なんで　そんな　馬鹿（ばか）な　こと　したの？
lesson_examples.en: Why did you do something stupid like that?

唱.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 昌 (phonetic ショウ) — the voice raised bright: to chant, advocate.
唱.mnemonic: One mouth, two suns of volume — となえる. 合唱: many mouths, one chant.

lesson_examples.jp: がっしょうで　唱（とな）える。
まいにち　唱（とな）える。

松.etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 公 (phonetic ショウ) — the evergreen lord of trees: the pine.
松.mnemonic: The public tree at every gate and New Year — まつ. 松島: pines with a sea view.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　松（まつ）です。
松（まつ）が　すきです。

倉.etymology: Pictograph: a granary — roof, door, and store-room stacked.
倉.mnemonic: The rice bank — くら. 鎌倉: the warehouse that ran a shogunate.

lesson_examples.jp: 倉（くら）に　こめを　しまう。
lesson_examples.en: We store rice in the warehouse.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　鎌倉（かまくら）です。

巣.etymology: Pictograph: birds' nests in the treetop — a nest, a den, a hideout.
巣.mnemonic: Twigs piled on the tree's crown — す. 巣立ち: leaving it, the graduation metaphor.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　巣（す）です。
まいにち　巣（す）くう。

隊.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + a phonetic — troops filing along the ridge: a unit, a corps.
隊.mnemonic: A column snaking down the hill — タイ. 自衛隊, 探検隊: squads of every stripe.

lesson_examples.jp: 救助隊（きゅうじょたい）が　来（き）ました。
これは　隊員（たいいん）です。

典.etymology: Pictograph: the sacred text laid on its stand — the canon: code, precedent, ceremony.
典.mnemonic: The big book on the lectern — テン. 辞典, 古典: the books that outrank books.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　特典（とくてん）です。
これは　辞典（じてん）です。

徳.etymology: Compound: walking (彳) with a straight-seen heart (直+心) — conduct upright at every step: virtue.
徳.mnemonic: Ten eyes watch the heart walk: it stays straight anyway — トク. 徳島: virtue with a bridge.

lesson_examples.jp: 徳（とく）の　高（たか）い　お坊（ぼう）さんです。
lesson_examples.en: He is a monk of great virtue.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　道徳（どうとく）です。

奈.etymology: Phono-semantic character borrowed almost purely for sound — most famous as the 奈 of 奈良 and 神奈川.
奈.mnemonic: The big altar syllable — ナ. 奈良: where the deer keep the altar.

lesson_examples.jp: 奈良（なら）の　おてらを　みたい。
lesson_examples.en: I want to see the temples of Nara.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　奈良（なら）です。

縄.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 繩): thread (糸) + a phonetic — twisted straw cordage: rope.
縄.mnemonic: The sacred rope on shrine trees — なわ. 沖縄: the rope of islands.

lesson_examples.jp: うちの　娘（むすめ）は　縄跳（なわと）びが　大好（だいす）きです。
lesson_examples.en: Jumping rope is my daughter's favorite.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　沖縄（おきなわ）です。

梅.etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 毎 (phonetic バイ) — the tree that blooms first every year: the plum.
梅.mnemonic: Every (毎) spring's opening act — うめ. 梅雨: the plum rains of June.

lesson_examples.jp: 梅（うめ）の　はなが　さいた。
これは　梅雨（つゆ）です。

博.etymology: Phono-semantic: 十 'complete' + 尃 (phonetic ハク) — learning spread wide: extensive; the extensively learned: doctor.
博.mnemonic: Ten specialties and one extra dot of genius — ハク. 博物館: the doctor's attic, public.

lesson_examples.jp: 博物館（はくぶつかん）に　いく。
これは　博物館（はくぶつかん）です。

媛.etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 爰 (phonetic エン) — a graceful lady: princess.
媛.mnemonic: The lady the rope of helpers surrounds — ひめ. 愛媛: the beloved princess prefecture.

lesson_examples.jp: 愛媛（えひめ）の　みかんは　あまい。
これは　媛（ひめ）です。

票.etymology: Originally sparks flying up — light slips of paper drifting: tickets, ballots.
票.mnemonic: Paper slips rising like sparks from the ballot box — ヒョウ. 投票: casting your spark.

lesson_examples.jp: トムには　投票権（とうひょうけん）が　ある。
lesson_examples.en: Tom has the right to vote.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　投票（とうひょう）です。

牧.etymology: Compound ideograph: cattle (牛) driven with the stick (攵) — herding: to pasture, raise.
牧.mnemonic: The herder's tap on the flank — まき. 牧場: the office of cows.

lesson_examples.jp: 牧場（ぼくじょう）で　はたらく。
これは　牧（まき）です。

養.etymology: Phono-semantic: 羊 (phonetic ヨウ) + food (食) — feeding the flock: to nourish, rear.
養.mnemonic: Feed the lamb until it's family — やしなう. 栄養: nourishment, itemized.

lesson_examples.jp: えいようを　とって　養（やしな）う。
まいにち　養（やしな）う。

梨.etymology: Phono-semantic: 利 (phonetic リ) + tree (木) — the orchard's crisp profit: the pear.
梨.mnemonic: The tree whose fruit pays (利) — なし. 山梨: pear-mountain, grape country ironically.

lesson_examples.jp: 梨（なし）を　むいて　たべる。
lesson_examples.en: I peel and eat a pear.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　梨（なし）です。

茨.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 次 (phonetic シ) — the thorn bush: briar; Ibaraki's first kanji.
茨.mnemonic: The hedge that bites back — いばら. 茨城: thorn-castle prefecture.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　茨（いばら）です。
これは　茨（かや）です。

岡.etymology: Pictograph: the ridge line — hill; a place-name workhorse (岡山, 福岡, 静岡).
岡.mnemonic: The hill three prefectures share — おか. 福岡: lucky hill.

lesson_examples.jp: 岡（おか）の　うえから　うみを　みる。
lesson_examples.en: Watching the sea from the hill.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　福岡（ふくおか）です。

阪.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 反 (phonetic ハン) — 坂's place-name twin: the 阪 of 大阪.
阪.mnemonic: The slope with takoyaki at the bottom — ハン. 大阪: the big slope itself.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　大阪（おおさか）です。
これは　阪（さか）です。

埼.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 奇 (phonetic キ) — the jutting land: cape; Saitama's opener.
埼.mnemonic: 崎's inland cousin — さい. 埼玉: cape-jewel prefecture.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　埼（さき）です。
これは　埼（さい）です。

栃.etymology: A kokuji — made in Japan: the tochi tree: horse chestnut; Tochigi's namesake.
栃.mnemonic: The tree Japan had to invent a kanji for — とち. 栃木: chestnut-tree prefecture.

lesson_examples.jp: 栃（とち）の　きの　みを　ひろう。
これは　栃（とち）です。

阜.etymology: Pictograph: the terraced mound — the left-side 阝's full form; Gifu's second kanji.
阜.mnemonic: The 阝 radical, standing alone at last — フ. 岐阜: fork-hill.

lesson_examples.jp: ぎ阜（ふ）けんの　やまやまを　あるいた。
lesson_examples.en: I hiked the mountains of Gifu.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　岐阜（ぎふ）です。

質.etymology: Compound: two axes (斤斤) over money (貝) — goods pledged against a loan, weighed at their true worth: substance, quality; a question probing that worth (質問).
質.mnemonic: The pawnbroker sets two axes on the counter and weighs your treasure's real worth — シツ. 質問 does the same to a claim: 'what's underneath?'

lesson_examples.jp: 質問（しつもん）は　ありますか？
他（た）に　質問（しつもん）は　ありますか？
lesson_examples.en: Do you have any further questions?

貸.etymology: Phono-semantic: 代 'substitute' (phonetic タイ) + money (貝) — money handed over in place of trust: to lend.
貸.mnemonic: Your cash steps in as a substitute (代) in someone else's pocket — かす. The pair to remember: 貸す lends out, 借りる borrows in.

lesson_examples.jp: ナイフを　貸（か）して下（くだ）さい。
はさみを　貸（か）してくださいますか。

堂.etymology: Phono-semantic: 尚 'lofty, esteemed' (phonetic ドウ) + earth (土) — a raised earthen platform for assembly: the hall.
堂.mnemonic: A packed dirt stage with a proud roof: the town's gathering hall — ドウ. 食堂 is the hall that smells best.

lesson_examples.jp: お堂（どう）で　いのります。
lesson_examples.en: We pray in the temple hall.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　堂々（どうどう）です。

圧.etymology: Simplified from 壓: the cliff's mass (厂) bearing down on the earth (土) — crushing weight: pressure.
圧.mnemonic: The whole cliff resting on one patch of ground — アツ. 気圧 is the sky doing it; プレッシャー the boss's version.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　低（てい）　血圧（けつあつ）だ。
トムは　高血圧（こうけつあつ）だ。

囲.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 圍): enclosure (囗) + 井 (phonetic イ) — walls drawn around: to surround.
囲.mnemonic: The village well with a fence on all four sides — かこむ. 周囲: everything inside your fence-line of attention.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　囲碁（いご）です。
これは　周囲（しゅうい）です。

易.etymology: Pictograph read as a lizard that changes color — change (the 易 of the I Ching); what changes without resistance: easy.
易.mnemonic: The lizard switches colors without effort — やさしい, エキ. 貿易 is nations doing the color-swap; 簡単より易しい.

lesson_examples.jp: この　もんだいは　易（やさ）しいです。
これは　容易（たやす）いです。

移.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 多 (phonetic イ) — seedlings transplanted bed to bed: to shift, transfer.
移.mnemonic: Rice moved seedling by seedling to the big paddy — うつる. 移動: the transplant, applied to yourself.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　移行（いこう）です。
これは　推移（すいい）です。

因.etymology: Compound ideograph: a person (大) lying on the mat (囗) that supports them — the thing an outcome rests on: cause, basis.
因.mnemonic: Whatever you find under the result when you lift it — イン. 原因: the mat the accident was lying on.

lesson_examples.jp: 原因（げんいん）を　しらべます。
これは　要因（よういん）です。

営.etymology: Simplified from 營: watchfires over connected quarters (呂) — the laid-out camp; to run its operations: to operate, manage.
営.mnemonic: Lamps burning over both offices — えいぎょう中. 営業: the fires are lit, come in.

lesson_examples.jp: 郵便局（ゆうびんきょく）の　営業（えいぎょう）　時間（じかん）は　何時（なんじ）からですか？
lesson_examples.en: When does the post office open?

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　営（いとな）む。

永.etymology: Pictograph: a river shown with its long branching course — water that runs on and on: eternal.
永.mnemonic: One drop more than 水: enough to run forever — ながい, エイ. 永遠: the river with no last bend.

lesson_examples.jp: 永（なが）い　あいだ、ありがとう。
lesson_examples.en: Thank you, for all this long while.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　永住（えいじゅう）です。

液.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 夜 (phonetic エキ) — flowing substance: liquid, fluid.
液.mnemonic: Water that works the night shift in your body — エキ. 血液: the busiest fluid on the payroll.

lesson_examples.jp: 液体（えきたい）を　こぼさないで。
これは　血液（けつえき）です。

演.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 寅 (phonetic エン) — water drawn out long: to extend, unfold; to unfold before an audience: to perform.
演.mnemonic: Let the idea flow out at full length under the lights — エン. 演説 unfolds words; 演技 unfolds a role.

lesson_examples.jp: ぶたいで　演（えん）じます。
これは　上演（じょうえん）です。

応.etymology: Simplified from 應: a heart (心) under the eaves — the heart answering what arrives: to respond, comply, apply.
応.mnemonic: Knock, and the heart under the roof answers — オウ. 応援 is answering with noise; 反応 answering by reflex.

lesson_examples.jp: 一応（いちおう）　聞（き）い　とくけど、明日（あした）は　制服（せいふく）だよね？
lesson_examples.en: I want to ask, just in case - we should wear our uniforms tomorrow, right?

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　応（こた）える。

仮.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 假): person (亻) + 反 (phonetic カ) — a stand-in flipped into place: temporary, assumed.
仮.mnemonic: Someone playing the part until the real one arrives — かり. 仮名: the 'borrowed names' that became hiragana.

lesson_examples.jp: 仮（かり）に　しました。
これは　仮定（かてい）です。

価.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 價): person (亻) + 賈 'merchant' — what the merchant says it's worth: price, value.
価.mnemonic: The stallholder squints at it and names a number — カ. 価格 is that number in print; 価値 what it's actually worth.

lesson_examples.jp: 私（わたし）って　生（い）き　てる　価値（かち）　ある　のかな？
lesson_examples.en: I wonder if I have any reason to live.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　価格（かかく）です。

可.etymology: Compound: a mouth (口) with breath forced out crooked — the grunt of approval: permitted, possible.
可.mnemonic: The examiner's single grunt: passable — カ. 可能 opens doors; 不可 slams this same kanji shut.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　可決（かけつ）です。
これは　不可欠（ふかけつ）です。

河.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 可 (phonetic カ) — originally the proper name of the Yellow River; then any great river.
河.mnemonic: The river so big it was just called The River — かわ. 銀河: the night sky's own 河.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　氷河（ひょうが）です。
これは　河（かわ）です。

過.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 咼 (phonetic カ) — going past the mark: to pass, to exceed; going too far: an error.
過.mnemonic: You were supposed to stop back there — すぎる. 食べ過ぎ, 働き過ぎ: the kanji of one step too many; 過去 is everything already passed.

lesson_examples.jp: じかんが　過（す）ぎました。
これは　過疎（かそ）です。

解.etymology: Compound ideograph: a blade (刀) parting the horn (角) from the ox (牛) — taking apart at the joints: to dissolve, to solve, to understand.
解.mnemonic: The butcher never forces: he finds where things already separate — とく, わかる. 解決 is doing that to a problem.

lesson_examples.jp: トムが　正解（せいかい）。
これは　弁解（べんかい）です。

快.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 夬 'burst open' (phonetic カイ) — the heart's dam breaking into relief: pleasant, brisk.
快.mnemonic: The blockage in the chest gives way: sudden clear water — こころよい. 快晴 is the sky's version of the feeling.

lesson_examples.jp: 快（こころよ）い　かぜです。
これは　全快（ぜんかい）です。

格.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 各 (phonetic カク) — the squared frame each piece must fit: the standard; where you fit it: status.
格.mnemonic: The lattice every beam is measured against — カク. 合格: you fit the frame; 性格: the frame you were born with.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　格好（かっこう）いい。
そんな　格好（かっこう）で　寝（ね）たら　風邪（かぜ）　引（ひ）くよ。
lesson_examples.en: If you sleep dressed like that, you'll catch a cold.

確.etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + 隺 (phonetic カク) — solid as bedrock: certain, definite.
確.mnemonic: Tap it: stone all the way through — たしか. 確認 is tapping twice to be sure.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　確保（かくほ）です。
これは　確立（かくりつ）です。

額.etymology: Phono-semantic: 客 (phonetic ガク) + head (頁) — the head's front: forehead; the plaque hung at that height: a framed sum, an amount.
額.mnemonic: The number on the plaque at eye level — ひたい for the brow, ガク for the bill. 金額: the forehead of an invoice.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　金額（きんがく）です。
これは　半額（はんがく）です。

刊.etymology: Phono-semantic: 干 (phonetic カン) + blade (刂) — carving the printing blocks: to publish.
刊.mnemonic: The knife cuts today's edition into the wood — カン. 朝刊: last night's carving on your doormat.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　週刊誌（しゅうかんし）です。
これは　月刊誌（げっかん）です。

慣.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 貫 'strung through' (phonetic カン) — the heart threaded onto a routine like coins on a string: habit.
慣.mnemonic: Do it enough times and the heart stops noticing the string — なれる. 習慣: coins of days, all strung.

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　慣（な）らす。
まいにち　見慣（みな）れる。

喜.etymology: Compound ideograph: the festival drum (壴) with a mouth (口) singing under it — music and voice together: joy.
喜.mnemonic: Drumbeat plus a mouth that can't stay closed — よろこぶ. Good news comes with percussion.

lesson_examples.jp: 喜（よろこ）んで行（い）きます。
嬉（うれ）しい　くせに。　素直（すなお）に　喜（よろこ）びなよ。
lesson_examples.en: I know you're happy about it. Why don't you just show it?

基.etymology: Phono-semantic: 其 (phonetic キ) + earth (土) — the tamped earth platform everything is raised on: base, foundation.
基.mnemonic: Before the walls: the packed square of ground — もと, キ. 基本 is that square, in study form.

lesson_examples.jp: この　物語（ものがたり）は　実話（じつわ）に　基（もと）づいています。
lesson_examples.en: This story is based on a true story.

lesson_examples.jp: 私（わたし）、基本的（きほんてき）に　一人（いちにん）で　いる　方（ほう）が　好（す）きな　んです。
lesson_examples.en: I basically prefer being by myself.

寄.etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 奇 (phonetic キ) — coming in under another's roof: to draw near, drop in; to leave in their care: entrust.
寄.mnemonic: Sidle up under the eaves out of the rain — よる. 駅に寄る: a small detour under a familiar roof; 寄付 leaves something behind.

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　寄越（よこ）す。
まいにち　寄（よ）る。

規.etymology: Compound ideograph: the grown man (夫) sighting along his compass (見) — the tool that draws true circles: standard, regulation.
規.mnemonic: The master checks the arc by eye and it is law — キ. 規則: circles everyone must stay inside.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　銃（じゅう）　規制（きせい）に　賛成（さんせい）だ。
lesson_examples.en: Tom is in favor of gun control.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　規約（きやく）です。

技.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 支 'branch' (phonetic ギ) — the hand's many branches of ability: skill, technique.
技.mnemonic: One hand, a dozen learned branches — わざ. 技術 is the orchard fully grown.

lesson_examples.jp: 特技（とくぎ）は　どこでも　寝（ね）られる　ことです。
lesson_examples.en: My special skill is being able to sleep anywhere.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　技（わざ）です。

逆.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 屰 'person upside down' (phonetic ギャク) — walking against the flow: reverse, contrary.
逆.mnemonic: Everyone else is going the other way — and you're inverted too — ぎゃく. 逆に: the conversational U-turn.

lesson_examples.jp: 逆（ぎゃく）に　なりました。
まいにち　逆（さか）らう。

久.etymology: Pictograph read as a person held steady from behind — made to last: enduring, a long time.
久.mnemonic: Propped so it stays put for years — ひさしい. 久しぶり: the kanji you say when the prop finally slips.

lesson_examples.jp: 久（ひさ）しぶりに　運動（うんどう）　したから　めっちゃ　疲（つか）れた。
lesson_examples.en: I exercised like I used to, and now I'm all worn out.

lesson_examples.jp: 久（ひさ）しぶりに　話（はな）せてよかったよ。　また　話（はな）そうね。
lesson_examples.en: It was good chatting like old times. Let's talk again some time.

救.etymology: Phono-semantic: 求 'seek' (phonetic キュウ) + 攵 'acting hand' — the hand reaching in answer to the plea: to rescue.
救.mnemonic: Someone calls; a hand actually arrives — すくう. 救急車: the whole kanji with a siren on it.

lesson_examples.jp: 救急車（きゅうきゅうしゃ）　呼（よ）びましょうか？
これは　救助（きゅうじょ）です。

旧.etymology: Simplified from 舊 (an owl over a mortar, phonetic) — the former, the old: what the calendar already used up.
旧.mnemonic: One thin stroke propping up an old sun — キュウ. 旧道, 旧姓: roads and names from before the renovation.

lesson_examples.jp: お母様（かあさま）の　旧姓（きゅうせい）は　何（なに）ですか？
これは　復旧（ふっきゅう）です。

居.etymology: Phono-semantic: body settled (尸) + 古 'old' (phonetic キョ) — staying where one has long sat: to reside, to be present.
居.mnemonic: Sitting in the same spot until the spot is yours — いる. 居間: the room the family's 居る happens in.

lesson_examples.jp: まいにち　居（い）る。
これは　居心地（いごこち）です。

許.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 午 (phonetic キョ) — the word that grants: to permit, forgive.
許.mnemonic: One spoken yes and the gate unlocks — ゆるす. 免許: the yes laminated into a license.

lesson_examples.jp: 許（ゆる）して下（くだ）さい。
トムを　許（ゆる）してあげたら？

境.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 竟 'come to an end' (phonetic キョウ) — where the land ends: border, boundary.
境.mnemonic: The ground runs out of your name here — さかい. 環境: everything on both sides of your fence, technically.

lesson_examples.jp: ここが　ふたつの　ちほうの　境（さかい）です。
lesson_examples.en: This is the border between the two regions.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　境（さかい）です。

均.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 勻 'evenly distributed' (phonetic キン) — ground raked flat: level, equal.
均.mnemonic: Rake until no clump wins — キン. 平均: the number that flattens the whole class.

lesson_examples.jp: 平均（へいきん）を　けいさんします。
これは　平均（へいきん）です。

禁.etymology: Compound ideograph: the sacred grove (林) around the altar (示) — ground no one may enter: forbidden.
禁.mnemonic: Trees around the shrine: step back — キン. 禁止, 禁煙: the grove, now in sign form.

lesson_examples.jp: 禁煙（きんえん）　席（せき）は　ありますか。
lesson_examples.en: Do you have a non-smoking section?

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　禁煙（きんえん）に　失敗（しっぱい）　した。
lesson_examples.en: Tom was not able to quit smoking.

型.etymology: Phono-semantic: 刑 (phonetic ケイ) + earth (土) — the clay form castings are pressed into: mould, model, type.
型.mnemonic: Press the clay, lift, repeat: identical every time — かた. 血液型, A型: humans sorted by mould.

lesson_examples.jp: あたらしい　型（かた）の　じてんしゃです。
lesson_examples.en: It's a new model of bicycle.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　髪型（かみがた）です。

経.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 經): thread (糸) + 巠 'warp' — the long threads a weave runs on: to pass through (経る), the scripture lines (経), longitude.
経.mnemonic: The warp threads everything else crosses — ケイ. 経験 is what has passed along your threads; 経済 the nation's weave.

lesson_examples.jp: 留学（りゅうがく）の　経験（けいけん）は　お　ありですか？
食中毒（しょくちゅうどく）の　経験（けいけん）は　ありますか？
lesson_examples.en: Have you ever had food poisoning?

件.etymology: Compound: person (亻) + ox (牛) — a person's head of cattle, counted one by one: an item, a case, a matter.
件.mnemonic: Counting the herd item by item — ケン. 事件 is the case the police count; 3件のメール the cases in your inbox.

lesson_examples.jp: その　件（けん）は　あとで　はなしましょう。
これは　件（けん）です。

検.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 檢): wood (木) + 僉 (phonetic ケン) — the sealed wooden tallies checked one against another: to inspect, examine.
検.mnemonic: Open the wooden seals and compare — ケン. 検査 at the clinic, 検索 in the search bar: same double-check.

lesson_examples.jp: 問題（もんだい）を　再（さい）　検討（けんとう）　してみます。
これは　点検（てんけん）です。

険.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 險): mound (阝) + 僉 (phonetic ケン) — slopes stacked steep: precipitous, perilous.
険.mnemonic: The hillside goes vertical where the path was promised — けわしい. 危険: the sign they bolt to it.

lesson_examples.jp: トムは　危険（きけん）から　逃（のが）れた。
これは　冒険（ぼうけん）です。

減.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 咸 (phonetic ゲン) — the waterline dropping: to decrease, dwindle.
減.mnemonic: Yesterday's mark on the well wall is above today's — へる. 減る: the tide going out of anything.

lesson_examples.jp: おかねが　減（へ）りました。
これは　削減（さくげん）です。

現.etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 見 'see' (phonetic ゲン) — the polished stone's luster coming visible: to appear; what is visibly here: present, actual.
現.mnemonic: Polish until the gleam shows up in person — あらわれる. 現在, 現実: the here, the now, the actually-so.

lesson_examples.jp: この　文（ぶん）は　現在（げんざい）　形（かたち）です。
lesson_examples.en: This sentence is in the present tense.

lesson_examples.jp: この　文（ぶん）は　現在（げんざい）　時制（じせい）です。
lesson_examples.en: This sentence is in the present tense.

限.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 艮 'immovable' (phonetic ゲン) — the ridge you cannot pass: limit, restriction.
限.mnemonic: The hill that ends the argument — かぎる. 限界: where the path and your legs agree to stop.

lesson_examples.jp: じかんに　限（かぎ）りが　あります。
これは　限（かぎ）りないです。

個.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 固 'solid' (phonetic コ) — one solid unit: an individual; the all-purpose counter 〜個.
個.mnemonic: One person, one solid piece, countable — コ. りんご3個: apples processed through this kanji.

lesson_examples.jp: 目（め）が　10個（こ）　あったら　5冊（さつ）の　本（ほん）を　同時（どうじ）に　読（よ）めるのに。
